# WL8 · Tin nhắn mẫu đã duyệt · Sửa mẫu tin nhắn

Group **WL · Đăng nhập, khung & mẫu tin (Next.js)** · dialog · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/templates`) · account `owner`

## Purpose
Dialog or drawer of [WL4](WL4.md) · Tin nhắn mẫu đã duyệt: Sửa mẫu tin nhắn. Page: Approved message templates: texts a doctor approved for proactive care messages (reminders, check-ins after a procedure, progress photos, promotions). Compose, edit, approve, switch off or on.

## Agent and care context
- A new or edited template is not used until a doctor approves it. These are the only texts that a `patient_channel` schedule may send by itself (kind "Nhắn tin"). Promotions are not sent to patients who opted out, and birthday messages are never sent automatically.

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `owner` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `kb.read` to open the page; `kb.manage` to compose and edit; `review.decide_clinical` to approve.
- Roles that can open the page: All five staff roles read (cs_staff and reception view only, WL5); owner and manager manage; doctor approves (WL9) but does not edit.
- Menu entry: "Mẫu tin" in the section "Zalo & CSKH", shown when the role holds any of `kb.read`.

## Key actions
- (actions of the page; this state or dialog adds the controls its Layout lists)
- "Soạn mẫu mới"
- Card: "Sửa", "Duyệt" (unapproved), "Tắt mẫu" / "Bật mẫu" (approved)

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- Sửa mẫu tin nhắn
- Sửa
- Mã không đổi được sau khi tạo.
- Mẫu đã được bác sĩ duyệt. Sửa nội dung sẽ xóa chữ ký duyệt và tắt mẫu cho đến khi bác sĩ duyệt lại.
- Mẫu vừa được người khác sửa. Đóng form và mở lại.

## Business rules
- Sign-in is by email and password only: no clinic code (one install = one clinic), the account is looked up by email; the session cookie is HttpOnly, with a sliding and an absolute limit (ARCH-AI01 section 8).
